commits.summary: Write the Lucene, JTS and RoaringBitmap verification cases
commits.body: Pin the landed ranges and describe public observations for integer index sorting, endpoint projection and subtype-array union. Record the source checks and all remaining submissions. The changed-file selector found no applicable tests.

commits.summary: Specify sketch, enum facet and CSV consumer behavior
commits.body: Cover serialized quantiles, document-level enum counts, resumable CSV byte positions and Jackson iterator exhaustion. Check the first seven cases against their submissions, landed revisions and pinned source paths.

commits.summary: Cover CDATA slices, Avro defaults, recurrences and schema reset
commits.body: Trace the four public scenarios through XML readback, IDL generation, calendar expansion and a second database lease. The Avro and calendar cases identify specific source-predicted counterexamples. The handoff checks cover the first eleven cases.

commits.summary: Specify pool eviction, reactive lifecycles and log rollover
commits.body: Track a rejected pooled object's replacement, both registrations under reactive disposal, bounded demand across set buffers, and file framing across consecutive log rotations. The source and claim checks cover fifteen cases.
